named_probes: Probe 1: static extraction of every field name placed into an outbound payload, diffed against the contract's allowlist.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): capture the payloads on the wire through a local intercepting proxy and enumerate the observed JSON keys - a field added by a serializer default or by an exception attachment appears on the wire but not in the constructor.
negative_control: control: a field known to be permitted must appear in both probes; a field known to be forbidden must be planted into a scratch build and be caught by the wire probe, proving the capture is complete
